chapters.title: The Thicket
chapters.summary: A dense stretch of thorn and old stone.

events.title: The Overgrown Chapel
events.body: The church stands abandoned in the thicket, vines on the walls and moss on the steps. It is empty, and it is still beautiful.

choices.label: Search the main halls
choices.body: The main halls are emptier than you expected. The pews are gone and the altars are bare. At the far end, a single torch still seems to burn, somehow.

choices.label: Take the stairs into the crypt
choices.body:
The crypt is a shorter trip than you expected. After a few turns of the stair, a great stone door stops you. It is locked.

Beside the door, a socket is cut into the stone — just the size of a tablet, or of some key from a forgotten age. Whether such a thing still exists is another question.

choices.label: Set the tablet into the socket
choices.body:
You set the tablet into the socket. The door fights you, then gives, grinding open on its own — slow and unwilling.

Beyond it is an armory. Even the monks had to defend themselves.
once: Gain Simple Boots, a Wooden Shield, and a Throwing Spear.

events.title: The Open Wood
events.body: The wood here is a little easier going than the rest of the thicket, and far less tangled with brambles. In the distance, a deer slips between the trees and is gone.

choices.label: Search the wood for usable timber
choices.body: You spend some time looking for wood that will actually be of use. There is enough of it here, if you are willing to cut and carry.

choices.label: Go hunting
choices.body: You follow the signs as best you can. It takes patience, but you come back with a pelt and a steak.
once: Gain a Pelt and a Steak.

events.title: The Temple Ruin
events.body: An abandoned ruin sits in the thicket. At first glance it is unremarkable — just a scatter of stone — but if you look longer, the shape of an old temple starts to come through. There might still be something left in the rubble.

choices.label: Search the ruins
choices.body: After some searching, you find an old stone tablet under a fallen slab. It looks very, very old.

events.title: The Bramble Recess
events.body:
The settlement sits in a recess in the mountains, reachable only by a narrow path. They used to close that path with a wall. The wall is still there, in pieces — the stone slumped and the gates long gone.

What remains of the approach is completely overgrown. Thick brambles fill the path from side to side. There is no way in but through.

choices.label: Fight your way through the brambles
choices.body: You force your way through the thick brambles. It is exhausting, and you pick up more than a few scratches along the way.
once: Move to the other side of the brambles.

choices.label: These brambles look dry — easy to burn…
choices.body:
You set the brambles alight. Heat rolls over the path, and the living wall collapses into ash and embers. When the fire dies, the way to the settlement stands wide open.

You reach the settlement and are greeted by distressed people. “The brambles — what happened to them? They were our only protection against the night demons. Our walls are really not up to date. We need to repair them as soon as we can. Do you know what happened? Could you maybe help us with the repairs?”

choices.label: Offer your help
choices.body: Thanks to your help — and the materials you offered — the wall is repaired quite quickly. The settlement is safe again.
once: The way to the settlement is free: Place sticker X. Gain the 'Helper' achievement.

choices.label: Pretend you know nothing
choices.body: They eye you with suspicion. “Sure… must be a coincidence, then. You can stay — but if you want a safe night, you’re going to need to hire some guards.”
ongoing: Resting in this settlement costs each character 3 gold.
once: The way to the settlement is free: Place sticker Y. Gain the 'Pyromaniac' achievement.
